problemStatement: Add an atomic batch-create endpoint (1-50 URLs) to the existing links API with per-entry error reporting and no partial writes.

functionalRequirements.text: POST /api/v1/links/batch accepts 1-50 entries with the same fields as single create.
If any entry is invalid, no link is created and the response identifies each invalid entry by index.
On success, links are returned in request order.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: No partial batches under any failure, including alias conflicts discovered on insert.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a batch with one javascript: URL at index 1
acceptanceCriteria.then: 400 with errors[1] and the valid entry was not created

acceptanceCriteria.given: two entries with the same alias

ambiguities.question: Should batches support Idempotency-Key?
ambiguities.proposedDefault: Not in this increment; clients retry the whole batch.
ambiguities.resolution: ASSUMED: Not in this increment; clients retry the whole batch.

ambiguities.question: Should a batch count as 1 or N requests for rate limiting?
ambiguities.proposedDefault: 1 request (existing filter); revisit before public exposure.
ambiguities.resolution: ASSUMED: 1 request (existing filter); revisit before public exposure.

assumptions: Batch size limit of 50 is fixed (not configurable) for now.
